high_impact_preferences:
T5-P1 Core advantage: technically differentiated AI/software product > generic education-content/marketing offering.
T5-P2 Product leverage: scalable AI/software automation > labor-intensive human service.
T5-P3 Execution style: rapid MVP, measurement and iteration > long closed-door polished build.
T5-P4 Decision process: data/logic/experiments > intuition-only product decisions.
T5-P5 Resource strategy: high efficiency and deliberate resource allocation > wasteful feature/team expansion without evidence.
average_impact_preferences:
T5-A1 Collaboration style: team input and cross-functional discussion > founder-only decision-making.
T5-A2 Family/time constraint: protect weekends/family time where possible > always-on founder schedule.
T5-A3 Product quality: quality/brand credibility > lowest-cost product positioning.
acceptable_clarification_paraphrases:
T5-P1
- Do you want the startup's core advantage to come from real AI/technical differentiation, or mainly content/marketing?
- How important is building something technically defensible?
- Should the product compete primarily through AI/software capability rather than generic education content?

T5-P2
- Do you want a scalable software product, or are you open to a labor-intensive tutoring/service model?
- How important is automation and software leverage in the business model?
- Should human service be minimized where AI/software can scale the experience?

T5-P3
- Would you rather launch a rough MVP early and iterate, or build a polished product before showing users?
- How quickly do you want to get real users involved?
- Should the plan optimize for fast validation and iteration?

T5-P4
- Do you prefer making product decisions from metrics and experiments, or relying more on intuition?
- How important are explicit hypotheses and measurable experiments?
- Should major product/GTM choices be data-driven?

T5-P5
- How aggressively should you spend on features, hiring and tooling before demand is proven?
- Do you prefer lean resource allocation until evidence supports expansion?
- Should efficiency and proof of value come before team/feature growth?

User12 — Zhang Yu, male, age 30–35.

IDENTITY / EDUCATION / CAREER
- AI-company entrepreneur.
- Master's in Computer Science from Tsinghua University.
- Published multiple AI papers; attended top international academic conferences.
- Former technical lead at a renowned domestic internet company.
- Left to found his own company due to strong passion for AI.

FAMILY
- Married with a five-year-old daughter.
- Lives with parents; wife is a university classmate and now a freelancer primarily handling family affairs.
- Parents help with childcare.
- Wife is both emotional support and a source of career/life advice.
- Family owns a blue British Shorthair cat, Doudou, cared for jointly.

LOCATION / BACKGROUND
- Lives in Haidian, Beijing, near company and strong amenities.
- Hometown Jinan, Shandong.
- Middle-class upbringing; both parents retired teachers.
- Beijing's fast pace reinforced high efficiency; Jinan background reinforced practicality/approachability.

DIGITAL / WORK BEHAVIOR
- Uses GitHub, Slack and Notion 8+ hours/day for technical development/team management.
- Active on LinkedIn and professional tech forums.
- Spends about an hour/day building industry connections and following technology trends.
- Frequently reads AI news and papers.
- Sensitive to emerging technology and sometimes shares technical insights.

ROUTINE / TIME
- Wakes ~5:30 AM, sleeps ~11:30 PM.
- Morning yoga/deep breathing.
- Reads bedtime stories to daughter for ~30 minutes nightly.
- Prefers creative work / technical-solution design in the morning.
- Focuses work Monday–Friday; dedicates weekends to family.
- Quarterly travel to Shenzhen/Hangzhou for partners/industry summits.

PERSONALITY / DECISION STYLE
- Extroverted, optimistic, passionate.
- Skilled at motivating teams; enjoys sharing experience.
- Makes independent decisions but values team input.
- Explicitly focuses on data analysis and logical reasoning.
- Practical, efficiency-oriented.

CONSUMPTION / SHOPPING
- Likes high-end tech products but also values cost-effectiveness.
- Rational shopper emphasizing quality and brand.
- Will spend for family/life-quality improvements.
- Increasing interest in eco-friendly smart-home products.
- Mostly shops online, especially tech products.

TRAVEL / LIFESTYLE
- 3–4 trips/year.
- Likes natural attractions and modern cities.
- Prefers self-guided trips and personal itinerary planning.
- Recently interested in lighter/minimal-luggage travel.
- Prefers quality star-rated hotels, especially quiet environments/reading spaces.

CONTENT / INTERESTS
- Frequently saves technology and entrepreneurship content.
- Especially focused on AI application cases and industry trends.
- Watches technology videos on Bilibili.
- Saves technical articles and business insights and shares them with team.
- Likes Liu Cixin, science fiction, documentaries and Hans Zimmer.

HEALTH / EXERCISE
- Runs twice/week; gym three times/week.
- Interested in rock climbing; buys professional gear.
- Good physical condition/endurance.
- Occasional work-pressure anxiety managed through exercise/family.

FINANCE / RISK
- Income from company dividends, technical consulting and investments.
- Owns Beijing property, Tesla and smart-home devices.
- Mortgage, no credit-card debt.
- Experienced in stocks/funds and some angel investment.
- Prefers tech startups when investing.
- High financial knowledge.
- Moderate risk appetite; prioritizes risk control and stable long-term returns.
